results.name: default: no parameter shows the original NTU / SGDx market; disconnected holdings ask to connect
connected as Alice: all-token overview lists nonzero tokens across registries, deduplicated, unfiltered by the pair
registry paging: the TokenFactory registry beyond the first 50 tokens is discovered
zero balances: hidden by default, shown on request, for an account that holds only NTU and SGDx
selecting DTT / SGDx switches every market-specific panel, updates the URL, and sends nothing to the wallet
a reload of the deep link keeps the selection (URL is the source of truth)
invalid, unregistered and unreadable market requests fall back to the seed market with a plain notice
Dashboard to Trade keeps the market, and Trade links back to the Dashboard with it
the dashboard ticket trades the selected market: Bob buys 4 DTT at a 2.2 limit; the order goes to the DTT book; escrow and fill are correct on-chain
after the trade the global overview shows Bob's new DTT without a reload
a token created in the app appears in the overview without a reload (in-app navigation only)
accessible controls: the selector and the zero-balance checkbox work by keyboard and have visible focus
layout at desktop, tablet and mobile: no horizontal overflow, no console errors
